course.title: System Development Project
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A private company deploys a smart agriculture system using IoT sensors, drones, and (15) [CO2] AI analytics to monitor crops and optimize irrigation in rural Bangladesh.
i) Examine the positive and negative societal implications of this system focusing on productivity and food security, cost, and accessibility and impact on traditional farmers.
ii) For the smart agriculture system, explain the meaning of risk = probability × consequence and identify one technical risk, one operational risk, and one environmental risk.
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in Script B)
